## 2. Recorded pricing fallbacks left out (rounds 16-30)

A fallback keeps the seller's last price (Nash in round 1). Leaving the rows out cannot undo their effect on later rounds, and negotiation-step failures are not recorded at all.

## 4. Exact two-sided permutation tests, price-Delta rounds 16-30, 5 vs 5 episodes

All 252 splits. 2/252 = 0.008 is the smallest possible p with 5 episodes per arm.

|---|---|---|
| ON minus OFF (registered comparison) | +0.541 | 12/252 = 0.0476 |
